deviations: Message is a sparse 7-variant set (user rest|error, assistant rest|pending|streaming|error, system rest) instead of the spec role x state 3 x 2 = 6. Streaming and error come from the brief; combinations that cannot occur (user streaming, system pending) are not drawn.

Message has no TEXT properties: author, time and body differ per role, and a TEXT property overwrites every variant with one default (feedback-builder finding). Edit the text in the instance; the user body is an exposed Bubble with its own content property.

Message head shows 'thinking…' (pending) and 'streaming…' (streaming) in mono caption in place of the time; a footer (tokens · time · durable offset) and a user error row ('Not sent · the connection dropped' + Retry) were added. Assistant error = Inline notice destructive with its action relabelled Retry.

Streaming caret: the text is a paragraph plus a tail row (last line + caret) at gap 0, because a caret cannot sit inline at the end of a wrapping text node. The caret is a 2px marker/default bar whose height is bound to type/body/line.
Bubble: the tail corner (bottom-start or bottom-end) is bound to radius/badge, following the code's tail idiom; spec says radius/card on every corner. Same in Utility (both 0).

Message scroller: overflow is shown with border/subtle edge rules (edge-top, edge-bottom) instead of gradient fades, so every paint stays variable-bound. The scroll-button keeps the Icon button's radius/control instead of the spec's lit 999 (owner note: shape literals must become theme variables).

Trace line adds a duration (mono caption) and a done icon (check, success/text); running uses Spinner tone warning to match the tool card. Connectors and Marker separator rules are 2px boxes with one border/width edge stroke, which keeps the 1px line on whole pixels.
Questionnaire choice selected stroke is primary/stroke, not primary/default: primary/default is graphite (#313131) in Utility dark and the selected row was invisible.

Attachment media reuses the Data display private helpers .Item icon tile and .Item image (resized to 40/32/24) instead of a new lit-40 tile; xs horizontal shows a trailing state glyph (Spinner, alert-circle, check) and no description.

Prompt input state is rest|focus|typing|busy|disabled (5) x compact = 10, not the spec's rest|focus|busy|disabled x compact = 8: 'typing' covers the brief; 'with attachments' is the attachments boolean; 'sending' = busy (send becomes stop, square). The compact field is a strokeless Input md, not the Textarea. The focus ring sits on the root per the spec (the code uses primary-border).

Model option is its own set with O8 Menu item metrics, not a Menu item instance, because Menu item has no selected or focus state. The selector button is a custom row (provider mono caption + label T.strong-sm + chevron), not a ghost Button, because the code's button carries a provider span. The menu opens below the button.

Tool call card status is pending|running|done|error (4) x open = 8, not running|done|error (3) x 2 = 6: pending is from the brief, and 'success' is the code's done. Badge tones follow the code's STATUS_VARIANT (running warning, done success, error destructive; pending neutral). A duration was added. Running shows Skeleton lines for the result; pending streams partial arguments; error renders the result in Code block / sm tone destructive.

Citation chip index is font/mono + type/caption + type/mono/style (the code is mono; spec T.caption). active = marker/default + text/inverse (the code's filled chip), not primary/subtle like hover, which made hover and active identical; primary/default would be graphite in Utility dark.
MCP UI widget root fill is surface/raised (the code), and a source row (globe, ui:// uri, 'sandboxed'; prop source) was added; frame H 176 instead of the code's 16rem min height.
No themes strip for the AI page: the brief asks only for the composed chat review; the style pass will cover AI later.

Code block (D8, built by the Data display 2 builder) is nested for tool arguments/results and trace output with header, copy, footer and line numbers off; its Code line text is overridden with JSON and syntax ranges bound to code/syntax/*. If the D8 builder renames Code line parts, these overrides may need a refresh.
ownerNotes: Utility look: chrome stays ink (Avatar agent tile, send/stop, active citation, caret, selected choice stroke); content uses semantic colour: tool and trace status use the status tones (Spinner warning, check success/text, alert destructive/text, Badge outline + 6px square dot).
Dark is designed: graphite user bubble and send button, light-ink active chip and selected stroke (primary/default is graphite in dark), raised graphite menus and tooltips.

Real-world content follows docs/site/ai/durable-chat.md and tutorials/chat: restored durable session marker, searchDocs tool card with citations, search:search_docs MCP call with a ui:// widget, streaming reply with a running call, busy composer, durable offsets in footers.
